description: GCP IAM policy audit — Offline audit of a Google Cloud IAM policy (JSON from gcloud projects get-iam-policy, or a bindings array). Flags allUsers / allAuthenticatedUsers grants, primitive Owner/Editor roles, Owner on service accounts, Editor on default compute/App Engine service accounts, privilege-escalation roles (serviceAccountTokenCreator, serviceAccountUser, projectIamAdmin, securityAdmin...), sensitive data roles, personal Gmail and (with org_domain=) external members, domain-wide grants, too many owners, deleted members, audit-log exemptions and missing Data Access logs. IAM conditions lower severity one level. Score, A-F grade and verdict PUBLIC_EXPOSURE / FIX_NOW / REVIEW / OK. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_gcp_iam_check
